cds.text: Find unknown values in addition and subtraction equations, using properties of numbers and operations
Explain multiplication and division as inverse operations and use this to build families of number facts
Recognise and use rules that generate visually growing patterns and number patterns involving rational numbers
Demonstrate proficiency with multiplication facts up to 10 x 10 and related division facts; extend to efficient mental strategies without a calculator
Find unknown values in multiplication and division equations using properties of numbers and operations
Find unknown values in equations involving brackets and combinations of arithmetic operations, using properties of numbers and operations
Create and use algorithms with sequences of steps and decisions that use rules to generate number sets; identify and explain emerging patterns

sentences.text: {{S}} plots pairs of numbers on a grid to show a straight-line pattern.
{{S}} uses graphs to solve simple equations.
{{S}} uses letters to stand for unknown numbers and recognises numbers multiplied by themselves, such as 4 × 4.
{{S}} uses letters to stand for unknown numbers when solving simple problems.
{{S}} creates number patterns using known multiplication facts.
{{S}} generates number patterns using times tables.
{{S}} recalls some multiplication facts and uses them to support calculations.
{{S}} has developed {{pos}} understanding of related multiplication and division facts.
{{S}} recognises that multiplication and division are opposites and uses one to solve the other.
{{S}} recognises that doubling a number gives the same answer as multiplying by 2.
{{S}} recalls multiplication facts up to 10 × 10 and uses them to solve worded problems.
{{S}} uses number properties, such as swapping the order of numbers, to work out related multiplication facts.
{{S}} writes expressions with letters and finds their value by replacing letters with numbers.

{{S}} writes a sequence of steps with decisions that uses a rule to build a set of numbers.
{{S}} explains the pattern that appears when {{s}} follows a number rule.
